other_conditions: Group must consist of at least four weavers/entrepreneurs each with a separate legal entity
Minimum of 24 shuttleless looms up to 230 cm width or 16 shuttleless looms of width 230 cm and above must be installed
Each beneficiary must have at least four looms
Only TUFS‑compatible machinery may be installed

Eligible beneficiaries include: State Government or its agency, a registered co‑operative society, a company formed under the Companies Act 1956, a firm under the Limited Liability Partnership Act 2008, or the local powerloom association
benefits_summary: Provides construction subsidy up to 40% for general beneficiaries, 75% for SC and 90% for ST, with maximum caps of ₹400, ₹750, and ₹900 per sq.ft respectively.
